name: RUSCUS / HESPERIDIN / ASCORBIC ACID 150/150/100MG 30 CAPSULES
description: A combination of Ruscus aculeatus extract, hesperidin methylchalcone, and ascorbic acid (vitamin C) is commonly used in medications and supplements to treat chronic venous insufficiency and hemorrhoids. These compounds work together to improve vascular health. Mechanisms and Effects Venotonic and vascular protective: The combination has a venotonic effect, meaning it helps constrict veins. This improves blood vessel tone and decreases venous stasis, reducing the symptoms of chronic venous insufficiency. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
